rules.title: ipam normalize client_ip from dns_client_ip
rules.description: NIOS dnstap events expose the querier IP in dns_client_ip. Promote to client_ip so the existing IPAM enrichment chain (PTR → client_fqdn) populates the Infoblox Operations dashboard's Auth DNS + Top Clients widgets.
rules.source:
rule "ipam normalize client_ip from dns_client_ip"
when
  has_field("dns_client_ip") &&
  !has_field("client_ip")
then
  set_field("client_ip", to_string($message.dns_client_ip));
end
